comparison_column: Portland Cement Shipments by State, Texas, Metric Tons (column 4)
table2a_source: USGS Mineral Industry Surveys, Cement, June 2025 edition, Table 2a total shipments (data/phaseB_inputs/usgs_mis_202506_table2a_total.csv)
reading: Through the last month equal to the Texas total the series is Texas Portland cement shipments; from the first unequal month it equals the U.S. portland-only all-destination total of MIS Table 2a (blended cement, including Type IL, excluded), so growth rates across the change of coverage are not economic changes. User ruling 2026-10-19: series kept, named and disclosed.
